basic_info.description: This one's got all the charm! Think classic Edwardian soul w/a total refresh why not? Charming Sunnyside 2 bed bungalow, updated w/a fresh, cottage-core aesthetic & modern upgrades throughout. This inviting starter home blends classic character w/thoughtful renovations. The spacious eat-in kitchen opens directly onto an entertaining deck, perfect for indoor-outdoor living. The living room features a wood-burning fireplace & stunning box-beamed ceiling. A newly remodeled bathroom w/modern vanity complements the home's original period details & whitewashed hardwood floors.  A spacious bedroom overlooks a large, level backyard, while the front bedroom accommodates a king-size bed w/large picture window & armoires for storage. Upgrades include a new roof, new electrical, & new plumbing. The oversized garage offers abundant storage, W/D, access to the yard plus rare driveway parking. An undeveloped attic provides expansion potential. At the rear of the landscaped garden retreat is a beautifully designed glass conservatory. This is a turnkey opportunity to own a fully remodeled home w/timeless charm in one of SF's most convenient neighborhoods w/access to Glen Park village, BART, 101/280, Balboa Park. It's everything you love about old homeswith all the hard work already done.
